aquis: aquí + se — here (aquí with the se of the following verb glued on as -s; Aquis conpieça 'here begins'; = aquí se comienza)
conpieça: començar — it begins (present 3rd sg., diphthongized -ie- stem; Aquis conpieça la gesta 'here begins the tale'; = comienza)
gesta: gesta — deed, tale of deeds, the poem itself (Latin gesta; la gesta de mio Çid 'the story of the Cid's deeds'; = gesta, as in cantar de gesta)
ducá: ducá — uncertain: in a las tierras ducá probably d'acá 'of this side, hereabouts' (de + acá), possibly a place or district name; no secure modern equivalent
mar: mar — sea (here fem., la mar salada; = mar, now usually masc.)
salada: salado — salt, salty (fem.; la mar salada 'the salt sea', the Mediterranean; = salada)
guerrear: guerrear — to make war, wage war (infinitive; conpeçó de guerrear 'he began to make war'; = guerrear)
orient: orient — east (apocopated; a orient 'to the east'; = oriente)
exe: exir — it goes out, rises (present 3rd sg.; exe el sol 'the sun rises'; = sale)
xérica: Xérica — Jérica, a town on the river Palancia in Castellón, north of Murviedro (= Jérica)
onda: Onda — a town in Castellón province, inland from Burriana (= Onda)
almenar: Almenar — Almenara, a town with a castle on the coast of Castellón, near Murviedro (= Almenara)
borriana: Borriana — Burriana, a coastal town in Castellón province (= Burriana)
conquistas: conquerir — conquered (old short past part. conquisto, fem. pl., agreeing with tierras and the object las; todas conquistas las ha 'he has conquered them all'; = conquistadas)
ayudól: ayudar + le — helped him (ayudó, preterite 3rd sg., + enclitic l(e); Ayudól el Criador 'the Creator helped him'; = le ayudó)
murviedro: Murviedro — a walled town near the coast north of Valencia, the old name of Sagunto (Latin muri veteres; = Sagunto)
vidíe: veer — he saw, he was seeing (imperfect 3rd sg., -íe ending, Pidal's vi[d]íe; ya vidíe que Dios le iva valiendo 'he now saw that God was helping him'; = veía)
valiendo: valer — helping, aiding (gerund; iva valiendo 'was helping'; = valiendo, ayudando)
viniessen: venir — (that) they come (imperfect subjunctive 3rd pl.; quel viniessen çercar 'that they come to besiege him'; = viniesen)
trasnocharon: trasnochar — they travelled through the night (preterite 3rd pl.; Trasnocharon de noch 'they rode all night'; = trasnocharon)
alva: alva — dawn (al alva de la man 'at dawn of the morning'; = alba)
viólo: veer + lo — he saw it (vio, preterite 3rd sg., + enclitic lo; Viólo mio Çid 'the Cid saw it'; = lo vio)
tomós: tomar + se — he took to, began (tomó + -s(e): after a stressed vowel -se shrinks to -s; tomarse a + inf. 'to set to, begin': tomós a maravillar 'he fell to marvelling'; = se puso a)
maravillar: maravillar — to marvel, wonder (infinitive; tomós a maravillar 'he set to wondering'; = maravillarse)
femosles: fazer + les — we do to them (femos, present 1st pl., the contracted form of fazemos, + enclitic les 'to them'; femosles tod mal 'we do them all harm'; = les hacemos)
bevemos: bever — we drink (present 1st pl.; bevemos so vino 'we drink their wine'; = bebemos)
comemos: comer — we eat (present 1st pl.; comemos el so pan 'we eat their bread'; = comemos)
partirá: partir — it will settle, resolve (future 3rd sg.; aquesto nos partirá 'this will be settled for us'; = resolverá; sense uncertain, perhaps 'will part, divide' our case)
vayan: ir — let them go (present subjunctive 3rd pl., jussive; vayan los mandados 'let the messages go'; = vayan)
deven: dever — they ought, must (present 3rd pl.; los que nos deven ayudar 'those who must help us'; = deben)
alucad: Alucad — variant spelling of Alucat, the mountain pass and place (see alucat; the d for t)
vengan: venir — let them come (present subjunctive 3rd pl., jussive; vengan acá 'let them come here'; = vengan)
conpeçaremos: començar — we shall begin (future 1st pl.; conpeçaremos aquesta lid 'we shall begin this battle'; = comenzaremos)
fío: fiar — I trust (present 1st sg.; fiar por Dios 'to trust in God'; yo fío por Dios 'I trust in God'; = confío)
eñadrán: eñadir (= añadir) — they will add, increase (future 3rd pl., syncopated: eñadirán > eñadrán; eñadir en algo 'to increase something': en nuestro pro eñadrán, Pidal 'aumentarán nuestro provecho'; = añadirán)
s: se — himself, themselves (reflexive pronoun cut to s’ before a vowel; juntados s’[a]n = se han juntado 'they have gathered'; = se)
compeçó: començar — he began (preterite 3rd sg., spelled with m; compeçó de fablar 'he began to speak'; = comenzó)
salve: salvar — may he save (present subjunctive 3rd sg., optative; sí el Criador vos salve 'so may the Creator save you'; = salve)
partiemos: partir — we parted, left (preterite 1st pl., old -iemos ending; nos partiemos 'we departed', with reflexive nos; = partimos, nos fuimos)
linpia: linpio — clean, pure (fem.; la linpia cristiandad 'pure Christendom'; = limpia)
ni: ni — nor, not even (continues the negative; non fo a nuestro grado ni nos non pudiemos mas 'it was not to our liking, nor could we do otherwise'; = ni)
pudiemos: poder — we could (strong preterite 1st pl., old -iemos ending; non pudiemos mas 'we could do no more'; = pudimos)
çercados: çercar — besieged, surrounded (past part. masc. pl.; çercados nos han 'they have besieged us'; = cercados)
quisiéremos: querer — (if) we shall wish (future subjunctive 1st pl.; si quisiéremos durar 'if we wish to stay on'; = quisiéremos, tense obsolete, now si queremos)
durar: durar — to last, stay on, hold out (infinitive; si en estas tierras quisiéremos durar 'if we wish to remain in these lands'; = durar, permanecer)
escarmentar: escarmentar — to chastise, punish (infinitive; son estos a escarmentar 'these are to be punished', a + inf. with passive sense; = escarmentar)
venga: venir — let it come (present subjunctive 3rd sg., jussive; venga la mañana 'let morning come'; = venga)
aparejados: aparejar — made ready, prepared (past part. masc. pl.; aparejados me seed 'be ready for me'; = aparejados, now preparados)
pareçrá: parecer — will appear, will show (future 3rd sg., syncopated pareçrá for pareçerá; allí pareçrá el que mereçe la soldada 'there will show himself the man who deserves his pay'; = parecerá)
mereçe: merecer — he deserves, earns (present 3rd sg.; el que mereçe la soldada 'he who earns his pay'; = merece)
fagamos: fazer — let us do (present subjunctive 1st pl., hortative; fagamos lo que a vos plaze 'let us do what pleases you'; = hagamos)
pido: pedir — I ask (present 1st sg.; que non vos pido más 'for I ask no more of you'; = pido)
firádeslos: ferir + los — you are to strike them (firades, present subjunctive 2nd pl. of ferir used as a command, old -ádes ending, + enclitic los; = que los hiráis, heridlos)
ferredes: ferir — you will strike (future 2nd pl., syncopated: feriredes > ferredes; bien los ferredes 'you will strike them hard', Pidal 'heriréis'; = heriréis)
quis: quis — each (Latin quisque, reinforcing cada uno; quis cada uno dellos 'each one of them'; no modern equivalent, = cada; uncertain)
alvores: alvor — dawn, first light (masc., usually pl.; con los alvores 'at daybreak'; = albores, alba)
ferirlos: ferir + los — to strike them (infinitive + enclitic los; ferirlos va 'he goes to strike them', ir + infinitive; = ir a herirlos)
apostol: apostol — apostle (d'apostol santi Yague 'of the apostle St James'; = apóstol)
yague: Yague — James (Latin Iacobus; santi Yague 'Saint James', the apostle, Spain's patron; = Santiago)
cuerda: cuerda — rope, cord (tanta cuerda de tienda 'so many a tent-rope'; = cuerda)
arrancarse: arrancar + se — to be pulled up, torn out (infinitive + reflexive se; arrancarse las estacas 'the pegs being torn up'; = arrancarse)
acostarse: acostar + se — to lean over, tilt, fall (infinitive + reflexive se; acostarse a todas partes los tendales 'the tent-poles leaning over on every side', Pidal 'ladearse, caerse'; = ladearse; not modern acostarse 'to lie down, go to bed')
tendales: tendal — tent-pole (pl.; Pidal: 'los postes sobre que están armadas las tiendas'; acostarse los tendales 'the tent-poles lean over and fall'; = postes de la tienda)
reconbrar: reconbrar — to recover, regain one's footing, rally (infinitive; Pidal 'recobrar'; ya quieren reconbrar 'now they try to recover'; = recobrar)
entróles: entrar + les — he fell on them (entró, preterite 3rd sg., + enclitic les 'on them'; entróles Álbar Fáñez 'Álvar Fáñez fell upon them'; = les entró, los atacó)
oviéronse: aver + se — they had to (ovieron, strong preterite 3rd pl. of aver, + reflexive se; aver a + inf. 'to have to': oviéronse a dar e a arrancar 'they had to give in and be routed'; = hubieron de)
arrancar: arrancar — to drive off, rout (infinitive; a arrancar 'to be routed', passive-reflexive sense, cf. arrancada 'rout'; = ser derrotado, ahuyentado; modern arrancar 'to pull up, start')
ques: que + se — who ... themselves (que, relative pronoun, + reflexive se; los ques pudieron escapar 'those who managed to escape'; = los que se pudieron escapar)
pudieron: poder — they could, managed to (strong preterite 3rd pl.; los ques pudieron escapar 'those who were able to escape'; = pudieron)
fechas: fazer — made, done (past part. fem. pl., agreeing with ganançias; las ganançias que mio Çid fechas ha 'the booty the Cid has made'; = hechas)
robavan: robar — they were plundering (imperfect 3rd pl.; robavan el campo 'they stripped the field'; = robaban)
çebolla: Çebolla — Cebolla, today el Puig, a hill-town some 18 km north of Valencia, taken by the Cid in 1093 (Pidal: a popular etymology of the vulgar Arabic diminutive jubayla 'little hill'; = el Puig)
sonando: sonar — sounding, ringing out, being spoken of (gerund; sonando van 'keep ringing out', ir + gerund, of his fame; = sonando)

__broaden__.es: seer — it is (present 3rd sg.) · also ser as perfect auxiliary of intransitives (exido es 'has gone out') and passive auxiliary (la tienda es cogida) · also es — that (apocopated esse = ese, demonstrative; en es alcaz 'in that pursuit', por es logar 'through that place')
__broaden__.estraña: estraño — extraordinary, remarkable, great (fem.; priessa much estraña 'a most extraordinary rush'; = extraña) · also estraño — foreign, strange (tierra estraña 'a foreign land'; = extraña)
__broaden__.avrá: aver — he will have (future 3rd sg., syncopated; aver a + inf. 'will have to': me avrá a dar 'he will have to give me'; = habrá) · also aver — there will be (impersonal, with i 'there'; dubda non i avrá 'there will be no doubt'; = habrá)
__broaden__.dar: dar — to give (infinitive; split future dar gelos [hemos] = se los daremos) · also dar salto 'to make a dash, sally' (salto davan); dar çevada 'to give barley, feed the horses' · also dar — to give way, yield (oviéronse a dar 'they had to give way'; = ceder, rendirse)
__broaden__.de: de — of, from · also de — by (the agent with a passive participle; = por) · also de — 'by (night)' (de noch), partitive 'of, among' (quinze moros … de los que alcançava; pocas de gentes), 'as' (de ganançia 'as booty'), 'from outside' (de fuera), 'on the right' (de diestro) · also 'about, concerning' (de mí non digan mal 'let them not speak ill of me') · also de — 'as if in' (commo de arrancada 'as if in rout'); 'in the manner of' (de guisa 'in such a way'); 'of, among' (de bivos pocos 'of the living few'); nominalized infinitive (del prender 'of the taking') · also de — 'with' of manner (de fuertes coraçones 'with stout hearts'); 'on' (de pie 'on foot'); 'from' of side (della e della part 'from both sides'); de cabo 'anew' (de + cabo, 'again'); de suso de 'above'; seños … de seños colpes 'with one blow each' · also de — 'in respect of' after an adjective (sobejana de mala 'exceedingly bad'); 'with regard to, about' (me plaze de mio Çid 'I am pleased about the Cid'); 'from, at the hand of' (de señor non ha graçia 'he gets no favor from a lord'); 'from' of origin (de moros fo 'it came from Moors'); 'at' of manner (de vagar 'at leisure', de + the noun vagar) · also de’ — Pidal's de’llaño, read as del llaño 'of the plain' (the article's l run into the ll; a reading, not certain) · de + infinitive after an adjective (de ir somos guisados 'we are ready to go') · also de + infinitive after a verb: començar de 'to begin to' (compeçó de fablar 'he began to speak'), piénssanse de 'set about' (piénssanse de armar), aver de 'to have to' (lo que ha de far 'what he has to do')
__broaden__.commo: commo — as, like (spelling variant of como) · how, that, in the way that (commo sirva a doña Ximena 'how he is to serve doña Ximena'); like (commo la uña de la carne) · also commo si + imperfect subjunctive — 'as if' (commo si escapasse 'as if he were fleeing') · commo que 'as one who' (commo que ira a de rey … es echado 'as one who has the king's anger and is cast out') · also commo — 'as soon as, when' (commo gelo a dicho 'as soon as he told it him'); 'since, as' (commo fío por Dios 'as I trust in God')
__broaden__.tornós: tornar + se — she turned back (tornó + -s(e): after a stressed vowel -se shrinks to -s) · also tornarse a + inf. 'to set to, begin' (tornós a sonrisar 'he broke into a smile', perhaps 'smiled again'; the Cid the subject) · also he turned (toward) (tornós a essa part 'he turned that way', the Cid the subject)
__broaden__.por: por — through, along, by, for · purpose, 'in order to' (por el reyno quitar 'to quit the kingdom'); por + inf. 'yet to be done' (tres an por troçir 'three remain to pass'); 'for, on behalf of' (por mio Çid) · also por — 'out of, because of' (por miedo 'through fear'); 'for (that reason)' (por tal lo faze 'he does it for that reason'); 'by way of' (por Guadalfajara); por + noun 'for the sake of' ; por coraçón 'willingly' · also 'for (a price)' (por quanto serié conprada 'for how much it would be bought'); 'by means of' (por carta 'by writ'); 'through, thanks to' (por mí ganaredes 'through me you will gain') · also por — 'on, during (a time)' (por aquesta mañana 'this morning'); 'by way of, through' (por medio de la llaña 'through the middle of the plain') · also por — 'in' after fiar (yo fío por Dios 'I trust in God')
__broaden__.fincar: fincar — to stay, remain (infinitive; = quedarse, closest quedar) · also fincar — to pitch, plant (tiendas a fincar 'to pitch tents'; = hincar)
__broaden__.nuevas: nueva — news, tidings (fem. pl.; sus nuevas legavan 'his news was arriving'; = noticias, nuevas) · also nuevas — renown, fame (las nuevas de mio Çid sonando van; Pidal 'renombre, fama')
__broaden__.so: so/su — his, her, its (unstressed possessive sg.; so çervicio = su servicio); also seer — I am (1st sg. present; = soy; so ayrado, 'I am in [the king's] ira') · lo so — 'what is his, his own' (neuter article + possessive; lo so puede menguar 'what is his may dwindle') · also so — their (so consejo 'their counsel', so vino 'their wine'; = su)
__broaden__.su: su — his, her, its · also su — their (aquella su almofalla 'that host of theirs')
__broaden__.piedes: pie — feet (old plural, Latin pedes; los piedes e las manos 'the feet and the hands'; = pies) · also de piedes de cavallo 'at full gallop' (Pidal 'a uña de caballo')
__broaden__.veer: veer — to see (= ver; two syllables) · also to review, inspect (troops) (mandó ve[e]r sus yentes 'had his men mustered'; Pidal: 'revistar') · also ir veer 'to go and attack' (iremos ve[e]r aquella su almofalla; Pidal 'atacaremos aquel su ejército')
